text: Choose your fighter! Selene Wraith! Three! Two! One! Fight! Here comes a new challenger! Last stock! Self-destruct! Game! Father Thorne wins!
brief: A booming, larger-than-life arcade fighting game announcer in his forties. Deep, powerful American baritone with a little grit, shouting with adrenaline-pumping hype into a stadium microphone. Every word punched with crisp hard consonants and clean sharp S sounds, dramatic stretched vowels on the big calls. Huge arena energy, clean close studio recording, no music, no reverb.
rule: drop a candidate speech-to-text did not hear back word for word (an invented name within 60% of its spelling) or whose S sounds score under 60% of the field median; rank the rest by boom-and-hype = z(presence: vocal effort) + z(pitch range: a lively read) - z(median pitch: a booming register)
